'''''Han Solo and the Lost Legacy: A True Story of the Scoundrel and a Scholar''''' was a publication that was written by the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] on the subject of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] discovery of the lost treasure of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. It was published by [[University of Rudrig Press]].
